bottleneck.description: Dominant China servo drive + low-voltage VFD supplier with ~40% domestic servo share; deep penetration into robot joint motors and industrial automation.

dependency.key_customers: Chinese industrial robot OEMs, EV battery equipment makers, CNC builders, humanoid robot startups
dependency.key_suppliers: Power semiconductor suppliers (STM, Infineon), rare earth magnet suppliers, MCU vendors

editorial.notes: Inovance is the largest industrial automation player in China with leading shares in general-purpose servo systems and VFDs, and supplies servo motors for ~70% of domestic robot joint applications. While Inovance dominates China, global servo competition (Yaskawa, Mitsubishi, Siemens, Rockwell, ABB) is strong and switching is feasible outside China, so MEDIUM reflects China-only qualification stickiness rather than global monopoly.
